## What is wrong?

Name the toolkit file/section and explain the expected versus actual behavior.

## Reproduction or evidence

Provide a minimal fictional or sanitized example. If relevant, include the toolkit commit and agent used. Do not include credentials, private code, machine paths, customer data, or live vulnerability details.

## Impact

What misleading conclusion or unsafe action could this cause?

## Suggested correction

What change would resolve it without adding unnecessary complexity?
